comment: The registry should hold only the "minimum sufficient set to unambiguously identify a product", but the data element table makes attributes like volumetrics, storage requirements, and shelf life mandatory, though they aren't necessary to identify a product (e.g., volumetrics is even stated to be for transport and storage capacity planning.)

reviewer.name: Lakshmi Balachandran, Obaroene Ogidiagba, Boluwatito Adeyemi, Sameen Babur, Srikant Mohan, Lauren Theis

public.text: The registry should hold only the "minimum sufficient set to unambiguously identify a product", but the data element table makes attributes like volumetrics, storage requirements, and shelf life mandatory, though they aren't necessary to identify a product (e.g., volumetrics is even stated to be for transport and storage capacity planning.)
public.suggestedRevision: State the criteria for what counts as foundational data, and re-check each data element against it. Elements for supply chain management only should not be in a cross-sectoral registry.
